title: Rethinking Sequence Compression with Test-time Regression
abstract: arXiv:2610.31574v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sequence compression is a fundamental operation and a critical information bottleneck in efficient language and multimodal models, and yet prevailing approaches based on pooling or learned projections remain underperforming. We revisit sequence compression through the lens of test-time regression: input tokens define a regression problem whose fitted coefficients form the compressed representation. Importantly, the regression problem is learned end-to-end via backpropagation, while its coefficients are computed efficiently in closed form during the forward pass. This leads to TTR-Compressor, a general alternative to conventional pooling and projection-based compression. We evaluate TTR-Compressor as the compressor for block-wise sparse attention and the visual token merger for multimodal large language models. On block-wise sparse attention, TTR-Compressor improves RULER performance over attention-based compressors by a large margin. For

translated_title: 基于测试时回归的序列压缩再思考
translated_abstract: 序列压缩是高效语言模型和多模态模型中的一项基础操作，也是关键的信息瓶颈，然而目前主流的基于池化或可学习投影的方法性能仍然不佳。我们从测试时回归的视角重新审视序列压缩：输入token定义了一个回归问题，其拟合得到的系数即构成压缩表示。重要的是，该回归问题通过反向传播进行端到端学习，而其系数则在前向传播过程中以闭式解形式高效计算。由此我们提出了TTR-Compressor，作为传统基于池化和投影的压缩方法的通用替代方案。我们将TTR-Compressor作为块状稀疏注意力的压缩器以及多模态大语言模型的视觉token合并器进行评估。在块状稀疏注意力任务上，TTR-Compressor的RULER性能大幅超越基于注意力的压缩器。
tldr: 提出TTR-Compressor，将序列压缩重新建模为测试时回归问题，其回归系数在前向传播中以闭式解高效计算并通过反向传播端到端学习，在稀疏注意力压缩和多模态视觉token合并任务上显著优于传统的池化与投影压缩方法。
en_tdlr: TTR-Compressor reformulates sequence compression as a test-time regression problem whose coefficients are computed in closed form during the forward pass and learned end-to-end via backpropagation, substantially outperforming pooling and projection-based compression in block-wise sparse attention and multimodal visual token merging.
